what_it_is.prose: Bharat Forge Ltd, founded on 19 June 1961 by Nilkanthrao A. Kalyani, is the flagship company of the Kalyani Group and one of the world's largest forging companies by capacity. Headquartered in Pune, Bharat Forge manufactures automotive components, aerospace components, defence components and oil & gas components. Its wholly-owned defence subsidiary Kalyani Strategic Systems Ltd (KSSL) handles all artillery / missile programmes (Bharat-52, MArG 155-BR, ATAGS, KRAS JV with Rafael — see KSSL entry). On 3 January 2023, Bharat Forge announced a strategic partnership with General Atomics Aeronautical Systems Inc. (GA-ASI), a subsidiary of General Atomics (USA), to manufacture main landing gear components, subassemblies, and assemblies of remotely piloted aircraft (UAVs) in India — a major move to boost India's UAV manufacturing capabilities. The non-binding MoU was filed with exchanges on 5 January 2023. Bharat Forge's defence portfolio includes artillery howitzers (Bharat-52, MArG 155-BR), UAV landing gear (GA-ASI partnership), and missile systems (via KRAS).
